m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: No more! The Umbra Queen's agents took the Elephant Prince through the Mammoth Doors to the numinous Graveyard beyond.
She ordered them to cover their tracks. The pedestal at the feet of the great statues must be able to see all who enter.
Her minions pulled out the pedestal's gem eyes and hid them nearby. You need a local guide to even have a chance to find them.
Hooray! I could see the barge burning from all the way over here!
<ITALICS>Look how many pallets of bricks and shadow artifacts they intend to bring back. No good will come of these relics. </ITALICS>
You are the outsider causing the Umbra Queen so much grief!
<ITALICS>You tap into the energy of the Eternal Flame and burn a powerful glyph into the boiler. </ITALICS>
The Overseer said the Elephant Prince was taken to the graveyard? I've heard rumors of the mystical Elephant Graveyard...
But I don't know how to find it!
There is a shadow-touched Elephant barge at the docks, filled with these evil black bricks from the quarry.
The barge captain, Aksil Blacktrunk, likely knows the way. Rap his trunk!
Also... take a shard of the Eternal Flame. Use it to put the barge out of commission. Keep those bricks away from Stone Town!
Track down the barge captain, Aksil Blacktrunk, to learn the way to the Graveyard. Also, wreck his barge!
